**Triage routing: `pm:queue` + `documentation` + `priority:p3`；`domain:engine` + `finding` 保留（已正确）。**
**并回答卡面留给分诊的那个问题：⇒ 单独修，⛔ 不折进后续的注释修复卡。理由见末节。**

分诊席（`session_01SwJQDFKe8tVit3BXQ9EfR5`，R+161）。⛔ 本席不认领、不派工、不写代码。`origin/main` = **`5315098`**（卡在 `e8c7956c4` 上测，其后 main 动过多次；下述读数全部重取）。

## 三处读数逐条复现，全部成立

**① 陈旧注释仍在树上**

```
packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-matcher.ts:312
  // and those are #13357's cells, `needs-user-decision`, held for the
```

**② 同包姊妹头部已经是过去时**

```
packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-matcher-null-value-and-comparand.test.ts:56
  * this file. They were `needs-user-decision` when #13494/#13495/#13549 landed;
```

**③ 裁决记录在 spec 侧**

```
packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-shape.ts:92
  * ## Refused BY RULING, 2026-08-31: a `null` list member (#13357)
```

⇒ 卡面「同一个包里，三十行之隔，把决策状态说成两个样，而**陈旧的那份是读守卫的作者先到达的那份**」—— 复核属实。

## 定级 `priority:p3`

无行为缺陷、无门变红、修法是纯注释（卡面已明确：`⛔ No arm, guard condition or behaviour changes`，且负向 pin `memory-null-list-member-unreachable.test.ts` 已经罩住那道门）。⇒ p3。

⛔ 但**不关掉**，理由用卡面自己那句，它比"注释不准"强得多：

> `needs-user-decision` **is a live protocol state with a named reader**（the maintainer's inbox）。A source comment that asserts a cell is sitting in that state, when the door two packages over refuses the shape by ruling, is the shape that **produces a second escalation of a settled question**。

⇒ 这不是文风问题，是**协议状态被源码谎报**。一个读到它的作者（人或 AI）会认为那两格还在等维护者，于是**把一个已裁的问题再升一次** —— 而维护者收件箱正是本仓最贵的那条队列。⭐ 这条值得写进派发词，避免接手人当成可有可无的措辞润色。

## `domain:engine` 正确

落点 `packages/drivers/driver-memory/` ⇒ 车道表 `drivers/driver-*` 归 **engine**。⚠️ 注意主题涉及 `packages/spec` 的裁决记录，但**要改的字在 driver-memory 里**，按锚定规则归 engine，⛔ 不因为"讲的是 spec 的裁决"而改判 spec。

## 回答卡面的问题：⇒ **单独修**

> Whether it is folded into a later comment-repair card in this package or fixed on its own is triage's to decide。

**单独修**，两条理由：

1. **#14426 的围栏是显式的，本站点在围栏外。** 卡面已经写清：那张卡的范围是「the #13553 guard's **comment** only，三个点名的散文站点」，本文本是**第四处**，且**存在于该 PR 的 merge-base**，所以⛔ 不是那个 PR 的缺陷。把它折回去等于事后扩大一张已定范围的卡 —— 正是本仓反复吃亏的那件事。
2. **它不需要等任何东西。** 三份佐证已全部在 `main` 上（见上），修法是同文件内一处括号的重新指向，验收就是读源码。⛔ 没有理由让一个零依赖的一处改动去等一张尚不存在的"后续注释修复卡"。

⇒ 现在就可派。⭐ 但若 engine 席同轮正好因别的卡进 `memory-matcher.ts`，顺手带上是合理的 —— **同 PR 可以，⛔ 但不要因此把本卡关成重复卡**，它得有自己的 closing keyword。

## 修法的现成模板（卡面已给，本席确认可用）

照 `memory-matcher-null-value-and-comparand.test.ts:56` 与 `filter-comparand-shape.ts:92` **已经在用的过去时写法**重新指向 2026-08-31 裁决即可。⭐ 并请保留卡面点明的那半句 —— `$eq`-only 豁免的**推理本身没有变**（把豁免写在**算子**上而不是写在"比较值是 null"上，**今天仍然是对的**）；变的只是「它当初拒绝一并搬动的那些形状，现在已在校验入口被拒，而不再是被held」。⛔ 别把推理一起改掉。

## 查重复核

卡面自查：#13357 / #13494 / #13495 / #13549 **全部已关**（它们是裁决与行为修复），而**没有一张是"记录决策状态的那条注释现在是假的"**。⇒ 不同的东西，⛔ 不是重复卡。本席未发现反例。

⭐ **Why a comment-only fix earns a card**, in the card's own words and endorsed by triage as the line to carry:

> `needs-user-decision` **is a live protocol state with a named reader** (the maintainer's inbox). A source comment that asserts a cell is sitting in that state, when the door two packages over refuses the shape **by ruling**, is the shape that **produces a second escalation of a settled question**.

⇒ An author (human or AI) who reads that comment concludes those two cells are still awaiting the maintainer, and **re-escalates something already decided** — into the most expensive queue in this repo. ⛔ Do not treat this as a cosmetic re-word.

**The stale text** — `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-matcher.ts`, around `:309-313`:

> *"…and those are #13357's cells, `needs-user-decision`, held for the maintainer."*

**Three independent records on the same tree say those cells were DECIDED** (⛔ re-derive all three — the card measured at `e8c7956c4`, triage re-took them at `5315098`, and `main` has moved many times since):
1. `packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-shape.ts:92` — `## Refused BY RULING, 2026-08-31: a null list member (#13357)`, with `:314` pointing the `nullListMemberError` door back at it and `:502` naming "the null-member carve-out (2026-08-31 ruling, #13357)".
2. `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:2973` — `feat(spec): refuse null in list-comparand positions — $in / $nin members and $between bounds (#13357, #13495)`.
3. ⭐ **The sibling header in this very package**, `memory-matcher-null-value-and-comparand.test.ts:56`, **already reads in the past tense**: *"They **were** `needs-user-decision` when #13494/#13495/#13549 landed"*.

⇒ **The package states the decision state two ways, thirty lines apart — and the stale one is the one an author reading the guard arrives at FIRST.**

⭐ **Triage answered the card's open question: fix it STANDALONE.** ⛔ Do not fold it into #14426 or any later comment-repair card. #14426's fence is explicit (*"the #13553 guard's comment only"*, three named prose sites); **this is a fourth site, outside that fence, and present at that PR's merge-base** — so it is not that PR's defect and never was.

⛔ **NOTHING BEHAVIOURAL MOVES.** The card is explicit and triage repeated it: ⛔ no arm, ⛔ no guard condition, ⛔ no behaviour. The negative pin `memory-null-list-member-unreachable.test.ts` **already covers that door** — ⛔ do not add a second pin for it, and ⛔ do not "improve" the guard while you are in the file.

⭐ **And keep the exemption's REASONING intact — only the parenthetical is stale.** Writing the `$eq` exemption over the **operator** rather than over *"the comparand is null"* is **still right**. What changed is only that the shapes it declined to move are now **refused at the validation entrance**, not *held*. ⇒ Re-point the parenthetical the way `memory-matcher-null-value-and-comparand.test.ts:56` and `filter-comparand-shape.ts:92` already do. ⛔ Do not rewrite the exemption's justification.

**Lane note, so you do not second-guess it**: the subject matter is a `packages/spec` ruling, but **the characters to change are in `driver-memory`** ⇒ `domain:engine` by the anchor rule. ⛔ Do not re-route to `domain:spec` because the text talks about spec.

**Grade `p3`** — no behavioural defect, no gate turns red, the fix is pure comment. ⛔ Do not re-grade upward on the strength of the escalation argument; that argument is why it is **not closable**, ⛔ not why it would be p2.

**Clause-② reading (this seat's, not binding)**: `no` — a comment. No exported symbol or signature moves and no request changes disposition. ⭐ Still run the instrument and state both limbs; a one-line report is fine when the diff really is prose, but say so rather than skipping it.

⚠️ **Not a duplicate**: #13357, #13494, #13495 and #13549 are all **closed** — they are the rulings and the behaviour fixes. ⛔ None of them is *"the comment recording the decision state is now false"*. If a gate or a reviewer calls this a dupe, that distinction is the answer.

⚠️ **This `Clause-②` reading is this seat's and is NOT binding on you.** Re-derive it from your own diff and re-declare it in your report. This seat got a tier call wrong in BOTH directions today (#14552 predicted a park that measurement retired; #14646 and #14935 declared `no` for diffs that widened a published surface) — every one was caught only because the round re-measured.

⚠️ **Instrument limit, stated because two rounds burned time on it**: `api-surface/` artifacts exist **only for `packages/spec`**. For any other package the published surface is its `files[]` + `types` (`dist/**`). The instrument that works: build at your head → swap the changed source file back to `origin/main` → rebuild → **diff EVERY declaration file the package publishes** → restore **byte-exact** and prove the restore (blob == HEAD blob AND `git diff HEAD` empty).
⚠️⚠️ **Resolve those declaration files from the package's `exports` map and `files[]`, ⛔ NOT from the root `dist/index.d.ts` alone.** Measured today on `@objectstack/platform-objects`: its root barrel is **11 lines of re-exports, byte-identical across a real ablation**, while the change surfaced only in `dist/audit/index.d.ts`. ⇒ A root barrel that only re-exports **cannot** change for an edit inside a subpath, so a byte-identical root barrel is **not evidence of anything** — it is exactly how a confident false negative is produced. The test is 「**does any exported symbol/signature move, or is any request newly accepted or rejected**」 — ⛔ not 「did the signature line change」.

✅ **The Corepack CI defect is FIXED.** `check-regen-pending.mjs --self-test` reddened `origin/main`'s own push build and six PRs today; PR #16002 landed as `f50c394da` (verified by content on `origin/main`). If you cut from current `main` you will not see it. If you DO see `Lint & Repo Gates` red on `check:merge-driver` with `✗ self-test failed -- 1 failure(s) (cases and floor)`, your base predates `f50c394da` — merge `main` and re-run. ⛔ Do not skip, disable or quarantine anything over it.

⭐ **Discipline notes earned the hard way today, all from real failures:**
1. **An ablation whose restore outruns its measurement produces a confident WRONG green.** A round hit exactly that — its mutating helper's own `EXIT` trap restored the file as it exited, and the suite then passed against the *restored* tree. Prove the mutation is on disk **before** measuring (anchored grep counts, or `git hash-object` != HEAD blob) and prove the restore **after**, **in one shell**.
2. **A failure count is not a reading about success while anything is still running.** Read `status` explicitly. This seat published a false 「the re-run cleared it」 today by counting only completed-and-failed.
3. **A zero symbol count needs its comment filter run FIRST** — code that *documents* an absence makes a bare count non-zero — and **every zero-hit grep needs a firing positive control**. A control aimed at a symbol that does not exist in the repo is not a control.
4. **`cancelled` is not `failed`.** On a PR whose head just moved, 「N lanes cancelled」 in the OLD head's run is `lint.yml`'s `concurrency: cancel-in-progress`, not evidence about that head. Read the RUN-level conclusion plus job timestamps against the new run's `created_at`.
5. **The shared verify lock is contended.** `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` returning **exit 99 is a timeout = NO READING**, ⛔ not a green and ⛔ not a red. Re-run to a real result and say so. Multiple rounds recorded 99s today (540s / 352s / 459s waits) with the holder alive and building normally — that is cost, not breakage.
6. **Shared-ref hazard**: `origin/main` moves under you when a sibling worktree fetches. Pin every diff and merge to a **sha**, never to the ref name. One round read 9 changed files that were really 5.


⚠️ **Do NOT run the gate sweep concurrently with a build in the same worktree.** `tsup` clears `dist/` before writing, so a gate reading built output mid-rebuild can go wrong in **either** direction — and ⭐ the wrong-GREEN half is invisible. Measured today: a `check:dts-closure` exit 1 that was an artefact, green on a settled tree.

⛔ **Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`** in a code PR — release notes are written centrally at release time. Your PR's input to them is its **changeset**. E3 (2026-09-05) 「已发布必修，其余立卡」 — "published" is a MEASUREMENT against built `dist/**/*.d.ts`, `dist/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs}` and `content/docs/**`, not a guess.

⛔ **Worktree-first** (one dedicated worktree, this repo AND any sibling you touch) and ⛔ **never `git stash`** — `refs/stash` lives in the common `.git` dir, so all worktrees share one LIFO stack and your `pop` takes another agent's entry while reporting success. Use a patch file or a wip commit. ⛔ Never force-push or rebase a pushed branch.

**Bump level**: additive widening of a published surface ⇒ at least `minor`. ⭐ **The act wins over the commit type** — the gate at `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` only refuses `major`, so it will not catch a `patch` that should have been `minor`.
